capability.summary: Fix F01–F12 and mobile toolbar clipping identified by comprehensive package QC, in existing PR #41 as explicitly requested by the user. This authorization overrides default GA-only product scope and fresh-branch routing. Implement portable validated sample imports, atomic latest-load commits, transactional revision-checked saves and visible recovery, complete sound-state persistence/reset, owned MIDI voice lifecycle, keyboard focus protection and startup retry. Preserve original failing captures and historical missing-proof findings.
